def facts():
    s = ST.Storage(DEV, 40)
    DEV.write(s.addr, np.full(20, 7, np.float16).tobytes())
    flat = np.frombuffer(FM.read(DEV, s, np.float16, 20), np.float16).tolist()
    key = FM.rows_key(10, 32)
    rows = np.zeros((2, 32), np.float16)
    rows[:, :10] = np.arange(20).reshape(2, 10)
    DEV.write(s.form(key, rows.nbytes).addr, rows.tobytes())
    s.wrote(key)
    padded = np.frombuffer(FM.read(DEV, s, np.float16, 20), np.float16).tolist()
    s.free()
    return {"flat": flat, "padded": padded}
